content.text: Clear pattern: latency spike starting at 22:08 driven by slow upstream calls to pricing.io-internal.svc (basket-total), owned internally by checkout-platform. No deploy/config changes recorded. This matches internal-dependency-failure.

hypotheses.subject: pricing.io-internal.svc
hypotheses.summary: io-shop's latency jumped from ~45ms/210ms (p50/p95) to ~1500ms/1700ms starting at 22:08:00Z, coincident with repeated WARN logs that the upstream pricing service (pricing.io-internal.svc, owned internally by checkout-platform) took 1500ms to answer basket-total calls for the majority or all requests in each minute. No deploy or config change was recorded for io-shop in the preceding hours, and memory/request volume stayed flat, ruling out a leak or code change in io-shop itself. The failure arrived through a dependency this organisation owns.
